description: Delegation kanban lane vocabulary mapped onto the ticket store's canonical enums. No schema-version bump, no migration: the ticket store enums stay low|normal|high|urgent x backlog|waiting|running|review|done|failed (scripts/helpers/ticket-schema.ts). Design: docs/designs/2026-11-01-hub-consolidation-design.md section 5.
sevFieldNote: SEV (SEV1-SEV3) is a standalone ticket field, not a priority alias; sevDefaultPriority is an initial-suggestion mapping only (SEV1 tickets additionally bypass triage: the triage command auto-readies them with a history[] marker).

priorityGovernance.p0Note: P0/urgent is settable by actor=user only (ticket.ts); hub-pm and spoke-pm actors are refused with a hard error.

spokeRaiseCap.note: Spoke-initiated raises are capped at +1 level per ticket per 24h (P3->P2 today, P2->P1 at the earliest 24h later); spoke raises never target urgent/P0.

threeStrikeCounter.note: gitignored JSON counter keyed by requesting project; 3 cap violations set frozen=true and further priority raises from that project are refused with a typed error pending user review.
